card.title: How to fix an iPhone 15 Pro Pro Max camera which is not focusing

source.title: How to fix an iPhone 15 Pro Pro Max camera which is not focusing

claims.statement: iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max with no autofocus and a dead compass after impact, unchanged by a known-good camera, often has a damaged gyroscope IC.
A gyroscope IC from an iPhone 14 Pro / Pro Max can serve as donor if no 15 Pro board is available.

procedure: Confirm with a known-good rear camera and the Compass app.
Remove the damaged gyroscope IC, clean pads, reball donor IC (15 Pro or 14 Pro).
Reflow, reassemble, test focus and compass.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
